citations.quote: Ana Botín. Presidenta del Consejo de Administración del Grupo Financiero Santander

claims.statement: Ana Botín announced the opening of Faro Santander on 8 September 2026, a cultural venue exhibiting the Gelman Santander collection and Banco Santander collection.

fact.value: Announced the opening of Faro Santander, a cultural venue in the renovated Pereda building (former Banco Santander headquarters), opening 8 September 2026 with the Gelman Santander collection and Banco Santander collection.

citations.quote: Ana Botín anunció la apertura del Faro Santander el próximo 8 de septiembre de 2026, un recinto cultural que exhibirá lo mejor de la colección Gelman Santander

claims.statement: Botín will officially inaugurate Faro Santander together with King Felipe VI, after five years of renovation of the Pereda building.

fact.value: Will co-officially inaugurate Faro Santander with King Felipe VI on 7 September 2026, after five years of renovation of the Pereda building.

citations.quote: Tras cinco años de renovación del edificio Pereda, el espacio será inaugurado oficialmente por el rey Felipe VI y la presidenta del Grupo Financiero Santander.

claims.statement: The Gelman Santander collection, managed by the Banco Santander foundation since January 2026, comprises 160 works of painting and photography from 1941 to 1998 and will be exhibited at Faro Santander from 8 September 2026 to 10 January 2027.

fact.value: The Gelman Santander collection (160 works, 1941–1998) has been managed by the Banco Santander foundation since January 2026.

citations.quote: La colección Gelman Santander es gestionada desde enero de 2026 por la fundación Banco Santander

contribution.text: Announced the opening and will co-inaugurate the venue with King Felipe VI

teamContribution.text: Building renovation carried out by the David Chipperfield architecture firm over five years

constraints.text: Followed five years of renovation of the Pereda building by the David Chipperfield architecture firm

outcomes.text: Scheduled public opening 8 September 2026 with free activities 8–17 September
